sloka: ततः स्वस्त्ययनम् कृत्वा मंत्रवित् विजय एषिणी ।अंतःपुरम् सह स्त्रीभिः प्रविष्टा शोक मोहिता ॥४-१६-१२॥
transliteration: tataḥ svastyayanam kṛtvā maṁtravit vijaya eṣiṇī ।aṁtaḥpuram saha strībhiḥ praviṣṭā śoka mohitā ॥4-16-12॥

translations.english: The wise counsellor, Tara bade him farewell, wishing him victory and then, overwhelmed with sorrow, entered the inner apartment followed by the womenfolk.
